question: Where can I find a fast food restaurant within 150 kilometers toward the north of Flagler Town Museum, Flagler, CO?
sql: SELECT poi_name, addr_city, addr_state FROM pois AS p WHERE p.amenity = 'fast_food' AND ST_DWithin( p.geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry::geography FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Flagler Town Museum%' LIMIT 1 ), 150000 ) AND degrees( ST_Azimuth( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Flagler Town Museum%' LIMIT 1 ), p.geometry ) ) BETWEEN 337.5 AND 360 OR degrees( ST_Azimuth( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Flagler Town Museum%' LIMIT 1 ), p.geometry ) ) BETWEEN 0 AND 22.5;
